svg.title: Detailed top-down gold mine illustration with black outlines, transparent background
svg.desc: A bird's-eye view detailed procedural gold mine in a strategy-game art style: a rocky outcrop cluster with a timber-framed mine entrance, glowing exposed gold veins, a small heap of mined gold nuggets, a short cart-track rail, and a crossed pickaxe and shovel, all rendered with bold black outlines for a cartoon-strategy look.
